literature.scope: motivation from the product-USD/Prange correspondence, not attribution of the affine theorem

mechanism: a positive uniform-affine-subspace mixture supplies both a coherent partial-linear-information instrument and a matched affine-constraint classical sampler
access_model: public explicit affine factor maps and efficiently represented known rational mixture; no comparison with classical state-only discrimination

proof_obligations.claim: branch l outputs sqrt(w_l)*(-1)^(d dot offset_l) times its exact linear information
quantum unique-reconstruction and classical full-row-rank matrices are transposes
codeword branch probabilities hold for arbitrary coherent priors
representation, affine membership, random coins and GF2 elimination are polynomially costed
random-sign average TV is at most3 times branch-proposal rank failure
mean unresolved load4c^2-c^4 is optimal within positive affine-subspace instruments
negative Gram entries escape the matched classical mechanism
these local decoder improvements establish an asymptotic quantum advantage

falsifiers: nonuniform coherent prior replaced with a codeword mixture
dual checked only on chosen branches
classical state-only access compared against public-factor access

next_target: actual scalable receiver not reducible to an efficiently represented low-load affine-erasure instrument, with full coherent source and normalization contracts and a stronger classical baseline
